Name: Easy Fence Builder
Author: SteckNy
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Build long stretches of fence without placing every piece individually. Fence Builder lets you preview and place straight horizontal or vertical fence lines using fences from your inventory.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Download and extract to the mods folder in SDV

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]How it works[/b]
[/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Select your fence pieces in the toolbar.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Shift + left-click[/b] the starting tile.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Move your cursor to preview the line.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Shift + left-click[/b] the endpoint to build.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]The preview shows [b]green[/b] for tiles ready to build, [b]red[/b] for blocked tiles, and [b]yellow[/b] where you need more fences. Press [b]Escape[/b] or [b]right-click[/b] to cancel.
Blocked tiles are skipped, and existing fences, objects, and crops aren’t replaced. Matching fence stacks in your backpack are counted automatically, with one piece consumed per successful placement.
Fences retain their normal durability and repair behavior. Gates are placed manually.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[b]Requires SMAPI 4.1.0 or later. No other mods required.[/b]
